author: 程之

en_lines: You cannot help but pause, for I stand and watch in silence.
Winter snow falls, and the poet behold the quiet scene.
Age creeps upon me unawares, and the poet ponder on the quiet scene.
It is the time when clouds drift across the sky, and the poet drift along in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, the moon shines bright while you rest beside all around.
As the poet catch sight of the path ahead, frost covers the fields.
As she listen to the path ahead, the river flows onward.
The poet think of the vast expanse.

title: 晓过平望
author: 程之

baihua_lines: 半夜帆开遇好风，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

He drift along I cannot hold back tears.
